question: Is the focused exact-head validation sufficient for this cross-path reconnect refactor, or should merge wait for one forced-disconnect lifecycle smoke?
rationale: The source and tests support the refactor, but only a maintainer can accept the residual availability risk or require live lifecycle evidence before merging this maintainer-scoped PR.

options.title: Require lifecycle smoke
options.body: Wait for an exact-head forced disconnect and shutdown scenario covering reconnect, stable-run reset, exhaustion, and cancellation.

options.title: Accept focused validation
options.body: Merge based on the broad focused Testbox suite and current CI while explicitly accepting the remaining live lifecycle uncertainty.

recommendation.title: Require lifecycle smoke
recommendation.body: Wait for an exact-head forced disconnect and shutdown scenario covering reconnect, stable-run reset, exhaustion, and cancellation.
